---
title: Fried Ricotta
id: MAR-0064
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g ricotta
- 60 g all-purpose flour
- 1 egg
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Drain the ricotta, completely removing any whey.
2. Cut it into cubes of about 4 cm per side.
3. Pass the ricotta cubes, a little at a time, in the beaten egg and then in the flour, removing the excess, and place them in the hot oil.
4. Turn them once and drain them when they are golden.
5. Place the ricotta cubes on kitchen paper, salt and serve.
